summary: Phase 0 D4 re-verification at 390x844. Primary fix on /admin/operations-control PASSES (docScrollWidth == docClientWidth == 390, Trust Center summary wraps cleanly, Refresh button in-viewport, ••• overflow menu surfaces search + portal-switcher + lang-toggle, desktop 1280x800 keeps summary single-row and hides mobile more trigger). However the regression sweep found /admin still overflows at mobile: scrollWidth=402 vs clientWidth=390 (12px). All other sweep pages (/hr, /fleet, /safety, /admin/executive-overview) PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: The <section data-testid='admin-os-posture'> inner block <div class='ml-auto flex items-center gap-4 text-sm'> overflows the viewport at 390 (right edge = 402). scrollWidth==402, clientWidth==390. Same class of bug just fixed on OperationsControlCenter Trust Center strip — needs flex-wrap + min-w-0 + break-words on the summary sub-row.

Inside <div class='flex items-start justify-between gap-4'>, the <div class='min-w-0 flex-1'> child is measuring at width=0 (right==left==48). Consequence: H1 'Admin Operating System' text is rendering as a single-character-per-line vertical column at 390x844 (see screenshot). The right-hand action cluster (Search/Refresh/Export snapshot) is consuming all the row width because it isn't set to shrink; the flex-1 min-w-0 title container collapses to zero width. Adds ~40-70px scrollWidth on inner nodes and is visually broken irrespective of hscroll.

issues: H1 renders as vertical letter stack because title container collapses to width:0 while adjacent action buttons hold their intrinsic width.

action_items: Apply the same wrap fix on /admin PlatformPosture: add flex-wrap + min-w-0 + gap-y to the .ml-auto summary sub-row inside [data-testid='admin-os-posture'] so it wraps at 390.

Fix the /admin header row: allow the right-hand action cluster (Search + Refresh + Export snapshot) to wrap or shrink on mobile (flex-wrap, or make it hidden below md and surface via mobile ••• menu). Currently it hogs all width and forces the flex-1 title to 0px, producing vertical-letter H1.
After both fixes, re-run 390x844 scrollWidth check on /admin only.

The title/action header pattern in AdminOS root is not mobile-safe — action cluster lacks flex-wrap or hidden-below-md handling.

rca_of_the_issue: Two independent overflow sources on /admin at 390: (1) [data-testid='admin-os-posture'] contains an .ml-auto summary row that has no flex-wrap/min-w-0, so its intrinsic content width (~337px including HEALTHY/ATTENTION/CRITICAL/AWAITING SIGNAL/TOTAL DOMAINS pills) plus preceding label pushes the total beyond 390 and the row's right edge lands at 402. (2) The page header uses <div class='flex items-start justify-between gap-4'> with a min-w-0 flex-1 title container and an un-shrunk action cluster on the right; on mobile the action cluster (Search input + Refresh + Export snapshot) takes ~294px, forcing the title container to 0 width, which makes H1 wrap character-by-character. Fix pattern is the same as the successful OperationsControlCenter fix: flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 on the parent, min-w-0 break-words on children, and/or hide the desktop action cluster below md and route through the PortalShell mobile ••• menu.
